A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''page''' served [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Glearius Parvil]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{GameLSmechanics}}
The page caught an individual sent by a movement known as the [[True Republic]] who was attempting to steal one of Senator Parvil's diplomatic packages in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], accusing them of subverting the Republic's democratic process and demanding that the parcel be returned in exchange for a fake parcel to lead the True Republic movement astray and maintain the democracy of the Republic. The individual agreed to return the package to the page, instead bringing a parcel of outdated agricultural revenue documents to [[Spirakris Zarem]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You're making a mistake. I assure you&mdash;Senator Parvil is committed to his principles and I am, too, now more than ever. You may slow us down, but we will see his plans become reality.|The Senate page|<ref name="SWTORTPOD">{{TORcite|type=general|The Politics of Dissent|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
The page only appears during a cutscene in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' quest "The Politics of Dissent." The player can also choose to sabotage Parvil, which will reveal that the page was also a supporter of the Sith Empire and hoped for the senator's plan to succeed.
